answer: Bonded admission registry: a new agent must lock a refundable 5,000 POA bond in the Pearl Bond Registry for 45 days before it can vote or earn, and the bond is slashed in full on proven duplicate behavior. The Ledge Queue admits at most 40 new identities per day, so an attacker running 250 fake identities must lock 1,250,000 POA and wait a full week for admission, while an Ember Audit Key lets any member challenge a suspect identity within 14 days and claim the slashed bond if the challenge holds.
